dialogue.translation: The construction we are doing is average, but the heat is causing a phase we haven't encountered yet.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Haddii aad qabow lahayd ka hor, ma ahaayeen inay noqoto dhabtaas.
dialogue.translation: If you had control earlier, it wouldn't have reached this phase.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Xaqiiqo, dhaqanka aan ku noolnahay waxay tusaale u tahay sidee aan u dhaqan jirno.
dialogue.translation: In reality, the culture we live in is an example of how we traditionally behave.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Haddii aad dhexdhexaad u sameysid, ma ahaayeen inay kuleylka aad u badan.
dialogue.translation: If you had done it averagely, the heat wouldn't have been too much.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Marka hortaada, waxaan u dhaqan jirnay in dhismaha ay noqoto si dhexdhexaad ah.
dialogue.translation: Then earlier, I used to think the construction would be average.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Laakiin xaqiiqo, dhabta aan ku noqonayo waa kala duwan.
dialogue.translation: But in reality, the phase we are in is different.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Tusaale, kuleylka waxay ka soo baxay dhexdhexaad, oo dhabta aan ku noqonayo waa kama dhexdhexaad.
dialogue.translation: For example, the heat came out of the average, and the phase we are in is not average.

key_phrases.translation: The construction we are doing is average.

key_phrases.translation: The heat came out of the average.

key_phrases.translation: The phase we are in is not average.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Maxaa fiiri weeye tijraad isku u hadlay dhabta AI-ga?
dialogue.translation: What do you think experts are discussing about the ethics of AI?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Waxaan u maleynayaa inay hadii ay isku fiiraan, waxay soo celin doonaan xaalad ku salan.
dialogue.translation: I believe that if they think together, they will come up with a good solution.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Laakiin hadduu AI-gu waa inay kuwa adag u qaadaan, maxaa u eg yahay?
dialogue.translation: But if AI takes over those difficult tasks, what is the concern?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Dhabta waa inay nala soo galin haddii ay AI-gu u talin doonaan qayb kitaabka.
dialogue.translation: Ethics must come into play if AI will take over part of the decision-making.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Fiiri, hadii ay kuwa adag u qaadaan, ma ayay u qaadi doonaan shuqulka?
dialogue.translation: Think, if they take over the difficult tasks, will they also take over jobs?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Laakiin waa inaan isku fiirno si aan u dhaqmo dhabta.
dialogue.translation: But we must think together to ensure ethics.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hadduu aad u fiirsan tahay, maxaa u eg yahay inay nala soo galin?
dialogue.translation: If you think deeply, why is it important for ethics to come into play?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Waayo, hadii ay AI-gu u talin doonaan, waa inay dhabta nala soo galin si aan u dhaqmo adiladda.
dialogue.translation: Because, if AI will take over, ethics must come into play to ensure fairness.
